scientific.integrity: The primary full-text PDF was consulted at the model equations, positivity, boundary equilibrium definition, Theorem 1 and its characteristic factor, and later discussion. A second related predator-disease source was consulted by abstract and access-gated full text; an older general source by abstract. A standalone exact-rational and numerical spectral checker accompanies the analytical proof. Independent audit has not been performed. The nonnegative periodic-orbit exclusion was checked directly through integration of the predator balance over one period. A closely related 2019 two-delay predecessor was compared by its abstract; complete text could not be obtained by open routes or authorized access, and the unresolved comparison is stated as a novelty risk.
scientific.limitations: Local spectral classification requires a positive predator-free endemic prey equilibrium; the global harvest criterion is sufficient rather than necessary and applies without endemic existence. The critical zero-root center dynamics, global prey convergence, and nonlinear Hopf criticality are not claimed. A potential mathematical Hopf branch near the predator-free equilibrium must be sign-changing in predator density when p>h; this statement is local and does not classify distant periodic dynamics. The ratio-dependent term requires strictly positive infected-prey history to avoid a 0/0 singularity when infected prey and predators are both zero in the history.

title: Sharp predator invasion and all-delay extinction barriers in a delayed eco-epidemic model
